name: B5·1 Loyalty & Referral — points on sale + tier upgrades + referral rewards (3 automations combined)

parameters.content:
## ⚙️ SETUP — step by step
1. Tab **Loyalty**: Name, Phone, Points, Tier, ReferredBy, TotalSpend. Variables: TG_OWNER_CHAT_ID, BRAND_NAME. Attach Telegram + Sheets creds; replace REPLACE_SHEET_ID.
2. Point of entry: `sale-in` webhook — POST {name, phone, amount, referred_by(optional phone)} after each billing (from your POS, the Suite CRM 'Sold' stage, or B4·1 orders via an HTTP node).
3. Rules (edit in 'Compute points'): 1 point per ₹100 · Tiers: Silver 0+ / Gold 5,000+ / Platinum 15,000+ points · Referral bonus: 500 points to the referrer.

## HOW IT RUNS
Sale in → customer found-or-created in Loyalty → points added, TotalSpend updated → tier recomputed:
• Tier upgraded → 🎉 congratulation message drafted (one-tap wa.me).
• referred_by present → referrer gets +500 points + thank-you message drafted.
• Owner Telegram summary for every event.

## 🔧 FIX
• Duplicate customers → phone is the key; always send the same 10-digit number.
• Change economics → the three constants at the top of 'Compute points'.
